Dialogs.Dialog: Is there anything you're into lately？
Anegasaki
Um, lately it'd be aromatherapy, I guess.
Aroma, like scents？
Right. Girls my age carry quite a lot of stress, you know？ We just don't show it.
I see. So that's why aromatherapy.
Yeah. Part of it is wanting to relax... but honestly, it's because it was cheap.
Because it was cheap？
Yeah. If it's just oils and candles, it's cheap, so you can enjoy it casually, right？
So there's a surprisingly practical reason too...
Girls, you know, it costs money just to keep ourselves presentable.
Are you still doing aromatherapy？
Anegasaki
Yeah. My room's already full of that kind of stuff.
Aroma pots, incense, perfume too. Ah, and lately massage oils, I guess.
You're getting more and more serious about it.
Not at all yet. You can never have too many favorites. So I'm researching every day.
If you get that absorbed, won't it stress you out instead？
Why？ It's fun？ Want to try it too？
Nah... seems like it'd stress me out...
Then, if I find a nice scent, I'll give it to you as a present.
Anegasaki
About my promise to find you a scent, would you mind if I called it off？
I don't mind... but what happened？
I'm thinking of quitting aromatherapy...
Why？ You were so into it？
It was costing way too much money.
Like, you bought too much？
It can't be helped, can it？ When I go to the store, there are so many kinds.
Ahaha. I guess so...
So, will you take my aroma goods？
That's... let's say, someday...
What happened with the aroma goods？
Anegasaki
Ah, sorry. Can we call that promise off？
Could it be you went back to aromatherapy？
Yeah. I realized if I stop buying new scents, I can enjoy it for a long time.
Yeah. I think that's good.
Right. Maybe it's a good example of how dabbling in everything ends in failure.
After all, you have to treasure just one favorite.
(...We are talking about aroma stuff, right？)
You liked horror movies, right？ Got any recommendations lately？
Anegasaki
I do, but... what kind of horror movies do you like？
What kind？
For example... grotesque ones with lots of blood.
Hmm, not really my thing？
Then what about movies like Japanese ghost stories that creep up on you slowly？
That's... hmm, I'm not sure？
Could it be you've never really thought about the differences？
To be honest... yeah. So I kind of want to watch what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ recommends.
Hehe. If that's the case, I'll bring a few next time.
Hey, about you bringing me some recommended horror movies before...
Anegasaki
Ah, yeah... sorry. Actually, I still haven't narrowed it down.
Could it be you've been picking them out ever since？
Well, even ordinary movies run 90 or 120 minutes, right？
...Watching dozens of them would be impossible, huh.
Watching that many in a row would wear you out, right？ So I was trying to narrow it to two or three.
But you still haven't narrowed it down.
There are five masterpieces in splatter alone...
Sorry, can you wait just a little longer？
Sure. More than the movies themselves, I want to watch what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ recommends.
...Okay. I'll choose properly, so look forward to it.
Anegasaki
Sorry. I promised to lend you my recommended horror movies, but... can we pretend that never happened？
If you can't, that's fine, but... did something happen？
...It's weird for a girl to like bloody movies, isn't it？
You think？
While I was agonizing over it, I remembered I like movies besides horror too, but...
Then it doesn't have to be horror...？
Yeah... but I think that's just me not wanting to show you a weird side of me...
What？
So, sorry. Can we save lending you movies for another time？
That's fine, but...？
About telling me your recommended movies, why did you call it off？
Anegasaki
Do I look like I'm forcing myself when I'm with you？
What do you mean？
Maybe I'm putting on a bit of an act... don't you think？
Hmm... aren't you overthinking it？
...You think so？
Yeah. Besides... are you even putting on an act？
Ah... hmm, so that's what you say. That hurt a little.
Um...
Hehe. Seems I really was overthinking it. Thanks. I feel a little better... maybe？
Really？ Then that's good...
Like, on a day off, is there anywhere you'd want to go？
Anegasaki
A hot spring... what would you do if I said that？
A hot spring... is there one around here？
Who knows？ If we go a bit farther, there are famous ones, but...
Then we'd have to stay overnight.
If we went, that's how it'd be.
I see, then that's out.
Hehe, disappointed？
Yeah, a little. So for now, I'll settle for somewhere nearby.
What's wrong？
Hehe. You're so cute▼
Anegasaki
What do you think about mixed-bathing hot springs？
Wh-what do I think...
Me, I want to relax in the bath, so I think separate is better than mixed.
R-right. Me too. Yeah, absolutely.
...Hehe. What were you imagining？
N-nothing improper...
Really？
Really！
Really, really？
...Sorry. Just a little...
Hehe. Since you apologized honestly, I'll forgive you.
Anegasaki
Talking about hot springs earlier made me think. Your skin is always so smooth. Do you do anything special？
I don't do anything... besides, isn't ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s smoother？
Hmm... but believe it or not, I have dry skin. When it gets cold, it gets rough right away.
Huh, really...
Maybe it's the age difference after all...？
That's not...
Aah, I guess I can't beat young people after all... big sis is a little shocked.
You worry too much. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s skin is prettier than the girls in my class.
...You think？ Yeah. If you say so, then it must be... yeah.
(Phew... looks like she didn't get upset.)
Anegasaki
Have you ever thought any of the girls in your class are... even a little cute？
Hmm... I've never looked at them like that...
Then how do you usually look at them？
How... classmates are classmates, right？ Isn't it the same for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh!? M-me？ Ugh, an unexpected counterattack...
I'm actually kind of curious, though...
...Yeah, seems classmates are just classmates for me too. I only noticed once you said it.
I see... I'm a little relieved.
Hehe. At least, the only boy I'd ever want to go to a hot spring with is you, okay？
Anegasaki
Magazines often have features on tasty ramen shops. Are you interested in that kind of thing？
Hmm... not totally uninterested, but not that much.
But you like eating tasty food, right？
Is there anyone who doesn't？
Girls, you know, are creatures who want to eat their fill of tasty food when they're stressed.
Sweets especially.
...Did something happen？
My friend's been going through a lot with her club... I want to cheer her up. Do you know any good places？
Hmm... sorry, looks like I can't help.
No, it's fine. I just suddenly thought maybe you would.
About cheering up your friend you mentioned, did that work out？
Anegasaki
Ah, yeah. Everyone ate cake together, and that solved it. Only...
Did something else happen？
No, more like something was done to me... I guess？
Done to you？ Did your friends do something to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
...I'm dating you, right？ Everyone kept asking about nothing but that.
R-right. It's the same for me, I guess？
Hehe. You too？ That kind of thing's a bit embarrassing, right？
More than embarrassing... it's kind of awkward, I guess.
Geez... don't say that while you're turning red. You'll make me... you know？
Anegasaki
How many guy friends do you have without girlfriends？
？ Um... a fair number, I guess？
Actually... some of my friends keep pestering me to introduce them to someone... you know？
I see. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friends... so they're a grade above me, right？
Yeah. Do you have any other friends who like older girls？
I don't think age matters, does it？
Then, can we all barge in sometime？ Into your classroom.
Barge in...
You know how I sometimes come to your classroom？ Everyone will just tag along. Is that okay？
Sure, but... hmm, will it be okay？
Anegasaki
About my friends I mentioned before...
Ah, the ones who wanted someone introduced...
Well, suddenly they all got boyfriends.
...Huh？
A junior from their club, a guy friend from cram school... they all confessed expecting nothing, and got a yes.
Huh... so they all already had someone they liked？
Seems so. Geez, what's with that. Hehe.
Haha... but that's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friends for you.
Huh, what do you mean？
In the end, they didn't rely on anyone and confessed to the people they liked themselves.
Right... yeah, I'm glad I worked up the courage back then too▼
Lately, it feels like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ isn't eating much... is it just me？
Anegasaki
Huh？ Ah... hehe, could it be you're worried about my body？
So something's wrong with your health？
No, no problem there. I'm not eating on purpose.
On purpose？ Why？
Geez... there's only one reason a girl skips eating on purpose, right？
Could it be... a diet？
Yes, correct. I'm right in the middle of working hard to get prettier.
I see... but they say overdoing a diet is bad for you, so...
Yeah. I'm careful about that. Hehe, thanks for worrying about me.
You might get mad if I say this, but... you're on a diet right now, right？
Anegasaki
Yeah, I am. Why would I get mad？
You're already plenty slim, so isn't there no need to diet？
Hehe... so that's your angle.
Sorry. But, you know, people often say extreme diets are dangerous.
Yeah, I'm careful about that.
I just think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is plenty pretty the way you are now, so...
...Do you hate me dieting that much？
I don't hate it. I'm just worried... sorry for saying something weird.
No... I'm really happy you feel that way.
Anegasaki
Is it true that guys actually like chubby girls better？
Um... I wonder？ Maybe girls who are too skinny do look kind of painful...
I see... hmm, then my diet ends today.
You were still doing it...
Yeah. I just didn't show it when I was with you, so you wouldn't worry.
Sorry, for making you go out of your way over something weird.
Hehe. It's something I did on my own, right？ Besides, it ends today.
I see... but why so suddenly？
Geez... no matter how thin I get, it's meaningless if you're not happy, right？
You've been eating a lot lately.
Anegasaki
Eh!? R-Really？
(Huh？ Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ flustered？)
No way, did he notice？ Because of the diet, my chest got just a little...
Y-you're imagining it. Yeah. I'm hungry... yes, I'm just hungry, that's all.
If that's all, then fine...？
Phew, looks like he didn't notice... geez, he's so oblivious.
What's wrong？
No, nothing. I was just thinking this kind of thing is part of the fun of being in love.
Anegasaki
Hey, what did you think of the outfit on the woman who was here just now？
Who？
You didn't see？ There was someone dressed all in dull reddish colors, head to toe, right？
Um... sorry, I don't really remember.
Hmm, she stood out so much, you know？ I'm glad your eyes didn't wander, but...
Really？ If it were a primary color, I'd notice, but...？
Primary colors... hmm, they're hard to pull off, aren't they.
...Could it be you're into clothes lately？
Well, of course... girls always care about that, you know？
...Sorry for being oblivious.
Anegasaki
Hey, was the woman we passed on the way here wearing a hat？
Hmm？ Was she... I think？
Geez, you don't remember？ She was a beauty who really stood out.
Um... sorry.
Hehe, don't apologize. What I want to know is what kind of looks stay in your memory.
I see.
Hehe. That side of you makes my heart skip.
(Huh？ Why is she in a good mood...？)
I see... even with a beauty like that, he didn't care. Hehe...
Anegasaki
What do you think of girls who wear lots of accessories？
Accessories？ Well...
For example... hmm, a girl wearing lots of rings？
Hmm... rings are a bit iffy, I guess.
Why？
Well, they seem like they'd get in the way when holding hands...
Ah... hehe. So at your age, you care more about that than about clothes？
No, well...
Oh my？ Why are you blushing～？
(Did I just switch on her teasing big sister mode...？)
You were talking about accessories before, but...
Anegasaki
Ah, it's fine. I've decided not to wear accessories, basically.
Really？
Hehe. If something hard and lumpy digs in when you hug me, it would kill the mood, right？
Yeah... well...
Or would it be better if I wore lots？ So many I'm noisy just walking？
That'd be a bit much...
So you too... okay？
O-okay... I won't wear that many either.
But if it's a special ring, that's a different story, maybe？ Hehe.
Could it be you're wearing perfume？
Anegasaki
You finally noticed？ Hehe. I was wondering what I'd do if you never noticed, you know？
Sorry. I noticed the scent a lot earlier, but...
How is it？ Too strong comes off tacky, so I only put on a tiny bit.
Yeah, this much is just right, I think.
Good. This perfume was pretty expensive, so I was worried in case it was a scent you didn't like.
Could it be... you went to the trouble for me？
Hehe. As a boyfriend, how do you feel about your girlfriend polishing herself up for you？
Of course I'm happy, but...
I'm having fun too. When someone's happy about it, it's worth the effort, right？ Hehe.
Anegasaki
Big sis is a little different from usual today... did you notice？
Geez... look, it's not how I look, okay？
Ah... the scent？
Correct. But if I have to tell you before you notice, it's not very rewarding.
Sorry. But I like how ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ smells.
Geez. Don't suddenly say embarrassing things.
Was that embarrassing？
...Sweet-talking your girlfriend like that, what are you planning？
Um... I want us to get closer, I guess.
...Geez.
You're not wearing perfume today.
Anegasaki
...Perfume is something old ladies wear, right？
Old ladies？ I don't think so...？
That's what I was told. By my mom.
I see... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s mom is against perfume.
She said I'm young, so I should go with my natural self... when she put it like that, she's right.
Young... that's not something a high schooler should be worrying about.
...From your point of view, I'm older, right？ Isn't that basically an old lady？
No way. If anything... you're, like, a big sister...
...Hehe. Sorry for troubling you. Big sis gets nervous sometimes too.
Anegasaki
I wore perfume today... what do you think？
Yeah, I noticed. I like a scent at about this level.
Hehe. You said that the first time I wore it too.
Did ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s mom give the okay？
Yeah. You know, in my case, I buy it with money I earned myself, right？
Ah... if it's for me, you don't have to push yourself...
Hehe.
What？
We're together all the time, right？ Did you notice my scent rubbing off on you？
Now that you mention it...
Hehe. Only a girlfriend is allowed to mark her boyfriend with her scent, you know？ Did you know that？
Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ interested in brand-name stuff？
Anegasaki
Ah, could it be you're thinking of getting me a present？
...It's not that, I just wondered if you were interested.
Sort of, I guess？
I knew it. Girls are like that.
No. Not because it's brand name. I mean I want to be around good things and refine my sense, so I can pick out what's really good.
I see.
Hehe. Did you think I'd beg you for something expensive？
Honestly, yes.
Don't worry. I earn enough to buy what I want myself.
Anegasaki
Haven't you noticed anything？
Um...
Too bad. Time's up. That's a little sad, maybe.
Sorry. What is it？
Actually... I went to a beauty spa.
A beauty spa？ Don't tell me...
Yeah. I told you before I wanted to polish myself, right？
So you really went and polished yourself...
But don't spas cost a lot？ Even with your part-time job...
It's fine. It was a free trial, so it didn't cost a thing.
I see... you surprised me.
But they recommended I sign up... what should I do？
(I have a bad feeling about this, but it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so it'll be fine... right？)
By the way, what happened with the spa membership？
Anegasaki
Oh, that. I passed in the end. When I heard the details, it was really expensive.
Right. That's for the best.
Huh？ Could it be you were against it？
I'm happy you're getting prettier, but lately it felt like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was trying too hard.
...You think？
I already like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ plenty the way you are now...
Geez. Saying such happy things. Okay, today big sis is treating.
I can't let you do that.
Even so, it's cheaper than starting at a spa. Right？
...Okay. Thanks.
Anegasaki
You asked me before if I was interested in brand-name stuff, remember？
Yeah, I did.
Actually... I bought something.
Eh？
It's a bag. I saw it in a store and fell in love at first sight.
But... wasn't it expensive？ And with the spa, you said it cost too much.
That's true, but I didn't stop polishing myself. I have to train my eye to recognize good things.
Even so, you'd better not overdo it.
I know where to draw the line. Besides...
Enjoying getting prettier for her boyfriend is a girlfriend's privilege. So please let me have that.
Anegasaki
A friend asked me for advice. What do you think of a guy who goes out with a girl who isn't his girlfriend？
You mean your friend's boyfriend is hanging out with another girl？
Right. Apparently he insists she's just a classmate...
So he might be cheating？
You think so too？
Isn't she overthinking it？ You know, if it's a classmate, hanging out together is...
Is that kind of thing normal？ Even if she's a classmate, she's still a girl, you know？
Um... anyway, the only thing to do is talk it over properly first, right？
Right. I'll tell her. Also... do you do that kind of thing too？
(...Uh-oh？ Did I walk right into that？)
What happened with your friend who was worried？
Anegasaki
Well, when she really asked, her boyfriend didn't see it that way at all, apparently.
So it wasn't cheating, just a classmate.
Right, but...
Something else happened...
A gap in how they see things, I guess？ She felt that gap, and now she's worried she doesn't understand how boys feel.
What kind of advice should I give at times like this？
Hmm. I guess the only way is to talk and close that gap...
Right. I'll tell her. Ah, by the way... do you think there's a gap between you and me too？ For example...
(...This is getting serious.)
What happened with your friend who asked for love advice？
Anegasaki
Seems to be going well. But...
Something else？
The places he invites her to are always arcades or karaoke, so there's no excitement, she says.
...Isn't that just bragging about her boyfriend？
I think so too, but when she asks if she should be the one to invite him, I can't not answer.
I feel like being so caring is backfiring on you...
Right. Time I told them to figure it out themselves.
Besides, even I don't understand how younger boys feel...
What did you just say？
No, nothing.
Are people asking you for love advice lately？
Anegasaki
No. Lately, I just hear how things are going on their end, I guess？
So you're finally free.
But, you know, because of that, I get stuck listening to her gush about him for hours.
...Sounds exhausting.
Hehe. So in return, I gushed right back.
About me？
Right. That I have a boyfriend who understands me really well. Hehehe.
That's kind of pressure...
Feeling that and trying your best is one of your good points.
Hehe, now I have one more thing to gush about▼
Anegasaki
Hey, do you know the drama "Loveless Rule"？
Just the name... it's the one on in the afternoon, right？
Yeah, that one. It's sooo good.
How do you watch it？
I record it every day and watch it when I get home.
It's worth that much, you know？
Huh, maybe I'll watch it too. Can I enjoy it from the middle？ Or, if you want, you could lend me your recordings...
Hmm, I don't know. You might not get it even if you watch.
Ah, I see. I guess it's made for women.
It's more that...
If anything, I might not want you to watch it...
Sorry, even though I was the one who brought it up.
(Now I'm even more curious...)
Huh, you seem kind of down？
Anegasaki
Yeah, I just remembered something... I wonder if women can never escape their past...
What are we talking about!?
The drama. You know, the afternoon one...
Ah. Oh, "Loveless Rule", right？
Right. She knows she'll be unhappy, so why would she throw away the happiness she has to cling to the past...
Sounds like a heavy story.
Yeah, heavy and heartbreaking. Women are creatures who live for love, and drown in love...
(Maybe I'm better off not watching it...)
Come to think of it, that "Loveless Rule" show. The Dixie's staff were talking about it too.
Anegasaki
Eh？
Apparently, last episode...
Wait！
What's wrong？
Lately, I haven't been watching it.
I see. Then I'd better not talk about what happened. But why？ You were so into it.
I've been recording it, but...
It's just too heartbreaking, I can't watch it. I want to know what happens, but I just can't press play.
That's...
But I have to catch up by the finale no matter what. Aah, what's going to happen？
Anegasaki
It's over...
What is？
"Loveless Rule". I watched the finale.
So you were able to watch the rest. How was it？
Hehe, it was good. In the end, it was a happy ending.
Huh, from there...
Yeah, midway I wondered what would happen, but in the end, everyone was happy. I think they wrapped it up a little too neatly, though.
If everyone ended up happy, isn't that good？
But, you know. Isn't love something that's hard and painful, and sometimes makes you cry？
Well...
Hehe, but that's just the drama. Let's be happy forever, okay▼
Anegasaki
If you went on a trip abroad, where would you want to go？
A trip abroad？
Yeah. See, there's a travel company ad over there, right？ It got me curious.
Ah, that's why... hmm, but where would be good？
Southern islands, or the fjords in Northern Europe... ah, going to see the horizon could be fun too.
Is there anywhere ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ especially wants to go？
Hmm... ah, your face says you want to see me in a swimsuit, so maybe a southern island.
It doesn't say that...！
Hehe. But South Seas resorts are nice, right？ They really feel like a trip abroad.
Anegasaki
I got some brochures for trips abroad. Want to see？
Continuing from the other day？
Right. Travel agency people, I guess？ They were handing out flyers, so I took some.
Let's see... Hawaii, Guam, the Maldives... it's nothing but South Seas resorts.
Hehe. Places like that are what you want, right？
That's... well, I don't hate them.
Then it's decided. Shall we look for somewhere nice？
We're really going on a trip？
We might be able to go someday, right？ For example... a premarital trip？
A premarital trip!?
Hehe. I mean I want you to choose that seriously.
So that's what you meant... you startled me...
Anegasaki
For our premarital trip, is it okay if it's not a southern island？
Premarital trip!?
Ah, no, no. Just a trip.
Right... ah, could it be about the trip abroad from before？
Yeah. It looks like the budget would be more than I thought.
Were southern islands that expensive？
If it's only one. But the island for day two is a bit far, so we'd need a plane, and if we go shopping after that, more travel...
...Could it be there's more than one place？
I can't decide on just one！ So maybe a different plan would be better.
Sigh... why are resorts so far apart？ If they were all close, it'd be so much easier.
(...That's unreasonable.)
The trip we've been talking about lately is just planning, right？
Anegasaki
Yeah. We're not going right away, though？
Good... it seemed like you were serious, so...
Hehe. But it's true that I hope we can really go someday, you know？
That's... how I feel too.
Then shall we decide together？ The place for our premarital trip.
Pre... I won't be surprised anymore.
...I was pretty serious, though.
Eh？
Hehe. Nothing▼
Anything interesting happen lately？
Anegasaki
Something interesting？ Ah, when I went to a department store the other day, they were having a bridal fair.
A bridal fair？ Like a wedding event？
Yeah. Pure white wedding dresses all lined up, and it seems they'll give you advice on weddings too.
Huh, so you're interested in that kind of thing after all？
I think every girl dreams of a wedding dress, don't you？
I see... you'd look beautiful.
Don't worry, you'll get to see it someday. Right from beside me.
Huh!?
Hehe. Kidding.
...For now, that is▼
Anegasaki
The other day, I tried going to that department store bridal fair I mentioned...
Is it okay to go to places like that if you have no wedding plans？
That's what I thought too, so in the end, I just hovered around the entrance and went right home.
Hard to go in, huh？
Well... yeah. I can't just say "Please show me the dresses" when I have no wedding plans at all, right？
True, if that's all, it might be a nuisance.
So I thought maybe I should go with someone...
Um, could it be...？
Hehe. I won't ask that much. It'd be a shame to drag you along just to window-shop... right？
R-Right. Ahaha...
Anegasaki
I went again. To the department store bridal fair.
Did you go in this time？
Yeah. I talked with the staff a bit... and at the end, they told me, "Please come back after you graduate."
So as a student, they treat you like a kid.
Yeah. People always say I'm mature, so it was kind of refreshing？
But... is marriage really such a far-off thing？
Huh？
Wanting to be with the person you love forever has nothing to do with age, I think...
That's... true, but...
Besides, I'm still in high school, but I'm old enough to get married, you know？
Just kidding, geez...
...About the marriage thing the other day.
Anegasaki
Huh, ah, no way. Geez... are you still hung up on that joke？
It's just that ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seemed kind of lonely...
Hehe. There's no way I'd be lonely. We're seriously dating, right？
Of course.
See, then there's definitely no way I'd be lonely. I can proudly say this isn't kid stuff.
...Right. I'll think more seriously about my future with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ too...
...Do you mean that？
Of course.
Okay... thank you. From now on, and long after that, stay with me forever, okay▼
